note: No sale or excess funds list is posted.

vital: The official tax sales page lists no sale at this time and does not publish the sale location, hours, registration or payment terms; call the Tax Commissioner before attending.
The county's last posted tax sale notice (July 1, 2025 on buttscountyga.com) pointed bidders to www.psageorgia.com for details.
Once levy and advertisement have started the office urges owners to pay in person, so parcels can drop off the list before sale day.
Georgia law (O.C.G.A. 48-4-40 to 48-4-45) gives the owner 12 months to redeem a non-judicial tax deed by paying the bid plus a 20% premium; this county's pages do not restate it.
